fluids.specification: Genuine NISSAN Motor Oil 0W-20 SP (or equivalent). If not available, a synthetic 0W-20 SP GF-6 motor oil may be used. Must meet API certification or ILSAC certification.
fluids.capacity: 6-7/8 qt with oil filter change; 6-1/2 qt without oil filter change

fluids.specification: Pre-diluted Genuine NISSAN Long Life Antifreeze/Coolant (blue) or equivalent. 50% antifreeze / 50% water factory fill. Provides antifreeze protection to −34°F (−37°C).
Genuine NISSAN Matic S ATF or equivalent. Do not mix with other fluids.
Genuine NISSAN Transfer Fluid for ATX90A transfer. Using other transfer fluid may damage the transfer.
Genuine NISSAN Differential Oil Hypoid Super GL-5 80W-90 or equivalent conventional (non-synthetic) oil
Genuine NISSAN Differential Oil Hypoid Super-S GL-5 synthetic 75W-90 or equivalent
Genuine NISSAN PSF or equivalent. DEXRON VI type ATF may also be used.
Genuine NISSAN Super Heavy Duty Brake Fluid or equivalent DOT 3
NISSAN A/C System Oil VC100YF (PAG) or equivalent
See Fuel information (P.10-4). Fuel capacity approximately 26 gal (US) / 21-5/8 gal (Imperial).

severe_conditions: Repeated short trips of less than 5 miles (8 km)
Repeated short trips of less than 10 miles (16 km) with outside temperatures remaining below freezing
Operating in hot weather in stop-and-go 'rush hour' traffic
Extensive idling and/or low speed driving for long distances, such as police, taxi or door-to-door delivery use
Driving on rough, muddy or salt spread roads
Towing a trailer, or using a camper or car-top carrier
oil_life_monitor: No oil life monitor described in the provided pages. The manual specifies fixed mileage/time intervals for oil changes (7,500 miles / 6 months for standard; 5,000 miles / 6 months for severe use).
extraction_caveats:
1. The maintenance schedule covers the VK56VD engine only, as that is the sole powertrain described in these pages.
2. Standard oil/tire rotation intervals are every 7,500 miles / 6 months; severe oil intervals are every 5,000 miles / 6 months.
3. The Intelligent Key battery is listed as 'inspect' at 22,500 miles and 'replace' starting at 45,000 miles, then every 22,500 miles (67,500 / 90,000 / 112,500).
4. Engine coolant first replacement is at 105,000 miles / 84 months; subsequent replacements every 75,000 miles / 60 months per footnote on page 560.
5. Spark plug replacement note: replace when plug gap exceeds 0.053 in (1.35 mm) even if within specified mileage interval.
6. Air cleaner filter replacement at 30,000 / 60,000 / 90,000 / 120,000 miles (standard); more frequent if operating mainly in dusty conditions.
7. Drive belts: first inspect at 60,000 miles, then every 15,000 miles (75,000 / 90,000 / 105,000 / 120,000); replace only if found damaged.
8. ATF, transfer fluid, front/rear differential, PSF, brake fluid, grease, refrigerant, and A/C oil capacities are listed as '—' (refill to proper level per procedure) in the capacities table on page 566; no numeric capacity is given for those fluids.
9. Fuel capacity listed as approximately 26 US gallons (21-5/8 Imperial gallons) per page 566.
10. The severe-use schedule brake fluid replacement pattern (every 10,000 miles) and transfer/differential replacement pattern (every 20,000 miles) were reconstructed from the repeating severe-use columns across pages 548–562.
11. Pages 608–610 were index pages and were removed from source_pages as no maintenance data was extracted from them.
12. The standard schedule transfer fluid and differential gear oil entries are inspect-only (visual leak check); replacement is only under severe schedule.
13. Severe schedule engine oil interval is 5,000 miles / 6 months; severe months column headers show varying month counts but the repeat pattern is every 5,000 miles.
